finding: the pipeline DETECTS volatility persistence decisively (beta +0.448, t +10.05, joint Wald p 7.8e-98) but REJECTS A TRUE NULL 17.1% of the time at a nominal 5%. CR1 p-values in this setting are anti-conservative.
implication_for_prior_nulls: an anti-conservative test is too eager to reject; every prior result was a FAILURE to reject, so the V2_PROXY and V3-Z1 nulls are strengthened, not weakened. Any FUTURE positive from this pipeline would need a far higher bar.
